Package cafe94.system.model.user

Class Staff

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.model.user.User
cafe94.system.model.user.Staff
Direct Known Subclasses:
Chef, Driver, Manager, Waiter
public class Staff extends User
Abstract base model for all staff roles in Cafe94 (Manager, Chef, Waiter, Driver). Stores working hours and staff type and supports persistence to and from file.
